list.name: avg_window
list.label: average window
list.query: selected range : ${__range_ms}, last 1 s : 1000, last 10 s : 10000, last 1 min : 60000

options.content: Pick **experiment → host**; **average window** is what the table, matrix, bars and tiles average over (selected range, or only the last 1 s / 10 s / 1 min, for live use); **resolution** is the finest bin of the time charts (auto = 6 ms, the data itself is 2 ms; coarser values average more). **XGMI per link** from `gpu_metrics`. Everything is computed from the sender's `xgmi_write_data_acc`: sent by the row GPU, and received = what its peers sent to it. Values are link bytes, not payload: a one-way copy shows 1.134× its payload (plus 0.57× on the reverse link); with both directions busy there is no fixed factor (MI355X, measured). Time charts are steps (each value covers the bin ending at its point); red dashed = highest single 2 ms interval, grey dashed = link capacity, gaps = no data.

panels.title: Total sent
panels.description: Sum over the selected GPUs of the average sent bandwidth (all links) in the averaging window.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (gpu) (sum by (gpu, peer) (sum_over_time(xgmi_bytes{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu=~"$gpu",dir="wr"}[${avg_window}ms])) / on (gpu) group_left sum by (gpu) (sum_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms]))))

panels.title: Total util
panels.description: Total sent / total capacity (links x link max) of the selected GPUs: the share of the XGMI sending capacity in use. This is link bandwidth utilisation, not the GPU engine utilisation. Needs the capacity labels (data recorded with this version).

targets.expr: sum(sum by (gpu) (sum by (gpu, peer) (sum_over_time(xgmi_bytes{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu=~"$gpu",dir="wr"}[${avg_window}ms])) / on (gpu) group_left sum by (gpu) (sum_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms])))) / (sum(max by (gpu) (label_value(last_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu=~"$gpu"}[${avg_window}ms]), "link_max_bytes_per_second") * label_value(last_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu=~"$gpu"}[${avg_window}ms]), "links"))) > 0)

panels.title: Busiest GPU
panels.description: The GPU with the highest average sent bandwidth in the averaging window.

targets.expr: topk(1, sum by (gpu) (sum by (gpu, peer) (sum_over_time(xgmi_bytes{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu=~"$gpu",dir="wr"}[${avg_window}ms])) / on (gpu) group_left sum by (gpu) (sum_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms]))))

panels.title: Hottest link (2 ms peak)
panels.description: The highest single 2 ms interval on any link of the selected GPUs in the averaging window, and which link.

panels.title: Last data
panels.description: Seconds from the newest sample (looked up in the hour before the end of the time range) to now. While recording 1-6 s is normal (VictoriaMetrics makes new data searchable after about 5 s); red means the recorder or the push stalled. For recorded data it shows how old the data is; no sample in that hour = no data.

panels.title: GPU overview (average over ${avg_window:text})
panels.description: Per GPU: average bandwidth sent / received over the selected range (all links), the same as a share of the GPU's capacity (links x link max), the highest single 2 ms interval on any of its links, and the trend of the sent bandwidth. Received = what the peers sent to the GPU (see the note on top). Util bars need the link capacity labels (data recorded with this version); older data shows no bar. Coverage = the share of the window that has valid sampling intervals; below 100 % the numbers cover only part of the window (a gap, or the window starts before the recording).

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (gpu) (sum by (gpu, peer) (sum_over_time(xgmi_bytes{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu=~"$gpu",dir="wr"}[${avg_window}ms])) / on (gpu) group_left sum by (gpu) (sum_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms]))), "gpu", "GPU$1", "gpu", "(.*)")

label_replace(sum by (gpu) (label_replace(sum by (peer) (sum by (gpu, peer) (sum_over_time(xgmi_bytes{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",peer=~"$gpu",dir="wr"}[${avg_window}ms])) / on (gpu) group_left sum by (gpu) (sum_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms]))), "gpu", "$1", "peer", "(.*)")), "gpu", "GPU$1", "gpu", "(.*)")

label_replace(sum by (gpu) (sum by (gpu, peer) (sum_over_time(xgmi_bytes{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu=~"$gpu",dir="wr"}[${avg_window}ms])) / on (gpu) group_left sum by (gpu) (sum_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms]))) / on (gpu) (max by (gpu) (label_value(last_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms]), "link_max_bytes_per_second") * label_value(last_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms]), "links")) > 0), "gpu", "GPU$1", "gpu", "(.*)")

label_replace(sum by (gpu) (label_replace(sum by (peer) (sum by (gpu, peer) (sum_over_time(xgmi_bytes{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",peer=~"$gpu",dir="wr"}[${avg_window}ms])) / on (gpu) group_left sum by (gpu) (sum_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms]))), "gpu", "$1", "peer", "(.*)")) / on (gpu) (max by (gpu) (label_value(last_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms]), "link_max_bytes_per_second") * label_value(last_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms]), "links")) > 0), "gpu", "GPU$1", "gpu", "(.*)")

panels.title: Sent: row GPU → column GPU (average over ${avg_window:text})
panels.description: Average over the selected time range. Row = sending GPU, column = receiving GPU. Sender's xgmi_write_data_acc; link bytes, not payload. Colour scale: 0 to 72 GB/s (one MI355X link).

targets.expr: sum by (gpu, peer) (sum_over_time(xgmi_bytes{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",dir="wr"}[${avg_window}ms])) / on (gpu) group_left sum by (gpu) (sum_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms]))

panels.title: Sent and received per GPU (average over ${avg_window:text}, all links)
panels.description: Average over the selected range, all links. Sent = this GPU's xgmi_write over its links; received = what its peers' xgmi_write sent to it (the receiver's own xgmi_read is not reliable over short windows when several flows arrive at once). Link bytes, not payload.

targets.expr: label_replace((label_replace(sum by (gpu) (sum by (gpu, peer) (sum_over_time(xgmi_bytes{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu=~"$gpu",dir="wr"}[${avg_window}ms])) / on (gpu) group_left sum by (gpu) (sum_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms]))), "dir", "sent", "", "")) or (sum by (gpu, dir) (label_replace(label_replace(sum by (peer) (sum by (gpu, peer) (sum_over_time(xgmi_bytes{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",peer=~"$gpu",dir="wr"}[${avg_window}ms])) / on (gpu) group_left sum by (gpu) (sum_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host"}[${avg_window}ms]))), "gpu", "$1", "peer", "(.*)"), "dir", "received", "", ""))), "gpu", "GPU$1", "gpu", "(.*)")

panels.title: Sent: GPU → GPU over time
panels.description: Same as the matrix, per time bin: one line per (sending GPU, receiving GPU) link. Steps: each value covers the bin ending at its point. Dashed grey = link capacity (xgmi link width x speed from gpu_metrics). Legend sorted by mean; click an entry to show only that link.

targets.expr: sum by (gpu, peer) (sum_over_time(xgmi_bytes{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu=~"$gpu",dir="wr"}[$__interval])) / on (gpu) group_left sum by (gpu) (sum_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu=~"$gpu"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Sent per GPU (all links)
panels.description: Sent by each GPU over all its links, per time bin (steps). Dashed grey = capacity of all its links in one direction.

panels.title: GPU $gpu sent, by peer
panels.description: Solid: average per time bin = bytes / time of the valid intervals in the bin. Gaps: no valid interval (nothing is filled with zeros). Link max is 72 GB/s per direction.

panels.title: GPU $gpu links (average over ${avg_window:text})
panels.description: One row per link of the GPU: average sent bandwidth, its share of one link's capacity, the highest single 2 ms interval and the trend.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (peer) (sum by (gpu, peer) (sum_over_time(xgmi_bytes{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu="$gpu",dir="wr"}[${avg_window}ms])) / on (gpu) group_left sum by (gpu) (sum_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu="$gpu"}[${avg_window}ms]))), "peer", "GPU$1", "peer", "(.*)")

label_replace(sum by (peer) (sum by (gpu, peer) (sum_over_time(xgmi_bytes{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu="$gpu",dir="wr"}[${avg_window}ms])) / on (gpu) group_left sum by (gpu) (sum_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu="$gpu"}[${avg_window}ms]))) / on () group_left () (max(label_value(last_over_time(xgmi_interval_seconds{experiment="$experiment",host="$host",gpu="$gpu"}[${avg_window}ms]), "link_max_bytes_per_second")) > 0), "peer", "GPU$1", "peer", "(.*)")

panels.title: Longest sampling interval per GPU
panels.description: Expected 2 ms. Longer = a snapshot was missed (no bytes lost, the rate just covers a longer interval).
